title: QUANTIFYING LATENT MORAL FOUNDATIONS IN TWITTER NARRATIVES: THE CASE OF THE SYRIAN WHITE HELMETS MISINFORMATION
reasoning: The paper's central theme is the quantification and analysis of moral rhetoric in Twitter data. It applies the Moral Foundations Theory and uses the Extended Moral Foundations Dictionary to operationalize five psychological dimensions of morality (Harm/Care, Fairness/Reciprocity, In-group/Loyalty, Authority/Respect, and Purity/Sanctity). This direct measurement and analysis of moral content is a core component of the study, not a peripheral ethical consideration.
